# Social Surge

> Bristol growth agency for e-commerce brands in any niche turning over £1M+ a year (or close) and advertising on Google, Meta or both; also helps service-based businesses. Google Ads and Meta Ads are managed hands-on by the team; email marketing, SEO, AEO, GEO and Google Tag Manager setup are run by Social Surge’s AI infrastructure with a specialist reviewing every change. Flat fees, full account access, weekly reporting, rolling monthly agreements, 18.3x average ROAS across managed accounts.

Founder: Jack Goldsmith. Contact: jack@social-surge.co.uk, +44 7796 374 758.

## Services
- [Google Ads management](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/google-ads-management/): Google Ads management from a Bristol agency: Search, Shopping and Performance Max built around margin, with full account access and weekly reporting.
- [Meta Ads management](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/meta-ads-management/): Facebook and Instagram ads for online retailers, DTC brands and service businesses: structured creative testing, Conversions API tracking and profitable scaling.
- [AI performance infrastructure](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/ai-performance-infrastructure/): A managed AI layer that analyses your Google and Meta ad accounts continuously: anomaly detection, change history, budget signals and automated reporting.
- [Email marketing](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/email-marketing/): Klaviyo flows and campaigns for retail, DTC and service brands, built by our AI infrastructure and checked by a specialist before anything sends.
- [SEO](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/seo/): Technical SEO, product and category optimisation and keyword-led content, run by our AI infrastructure with every change reviewed by a specialist.
- [AEO](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/aeo/): Answer engine optimisation for Google AI Overviews, featured snippets and voice search. Run by our AI infrastructure with specialist review.
- [GEO](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/geo/): Generative engine optimisation to get your brand named by ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Copilot. Run by our AI infrastructure with specialist review.
- [Google Tag Manager setup](https://social-surge.co.uk/services/google-tag-manager-setup/): Google Tag Manager setup for GA4, Google Ads enhanced conversions, Meta Conversions API and Consent Mode v2. Configured by AI, verified by a specialist.

## Pricing
- [Pricing](https://social-surge.co.uk/pricing/): starting prices: Google Ads from £1,650/month, Meta Ads from £1,650/month, combined from £2,250/month, AI infrastructure from £1,105/month inc VAT. Final fee depends on revenue, ad spend and scope. No percentage of spend, no contracts.

## Proof
- [Case studies](https://social-surge.co.uk/case-studies/): £1.62M revenue in 92 days; £2.5M growth in 12 months; 144% more conversions on 16% less spend; +23.6% revenue with AI analysis.

## Free tools
- [Search term savings](https://social-surge.co.uk/tools/search-term-savings-calculator/): What you spend on searches that never buy, and what a negative keyword script would recover.
- [POAS calculator](https://social-surge.co.uk/tools/poas-calculator/): Profit on ad spend and break-even point, from your margin, fees and delivery.
- [Break-even ROAS](https://social-surge.co.uk/tools/break-even-roas-calculator/): The minimum ROAS before ads lose money, and the target for your profit goal.
- [Google Ads health check](https://social-surge.co.uk/tools/google-ads-health-check/): Eight questions, a score out of 100 and your top three fixes.
- [Budget pacing](https://social-surge.co.uk/tools/ad-budget-pacing-calculator/): Whether this month’s spend is on track, and the daily budget you need from here.
- [Black Friday planner](https://social-surge.co.uk/tools/black-friday-budget-planner/): The November ad budget your revenue target needs, split across the peak.
